newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index flat after local holiday.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index flat after local holiday.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was hardly changed following a local market holiday in India on Tuesday.
The index added 0.06 points, or 0.07 percent to 81.14, with the premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market up at 19.04 percent from 18.85 percent on Monday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
